User.description: A human, software, or agent identity represented by a SCIM User resource.

Group.description: A persistent collection of SCIM Users or Groups.

EnterpriseUser.description: A SCIM User carrying enterprise organizational attributes.

Active.description: The enabled or disabled condition of a SCIM User.

Membership.description: A Group's inclusion of a SCIM User or Group as a member.

Manager.description: An EnterpriseUser's reporting relationship to a managing User.

RoleAssignment.description: A SCIM User's assignment to a declared organizational Role.

alignment.law: A SCIM resource id identifies its ONTOK Entity; it does not create a separate identity Node.
A SCIM externalId identifies the Entity within its originating system.
A SCIM User's active attribute determines its Active State.
Each SCIM Group member becomes one Membership Relation.
An EnterpriseUser manager reference becomes one Manager Relation.
A SCIM role value becomes a RoleAssignment only after resolving to a declared Role.
All other SCIM attributes remain fields of their Entity rather than becoming generic Nodes.
SCIM identity data does not confer organizational authority; ONTOK Rules govern Actions.
Successful SCIM protocol mutations are memorialized by ONTOK Events.
